A '''clone trooper''' was stationed as part of [[Resolute command/Legends|''Resolute'' command]] on a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], and participated in the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> under command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. During the battle, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] informed Ahsoka that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|warships]] were closing in on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces. Later, this clone was ordered by Ahsoka to commence fire on the enemy ships.
